title: Mel Stride and Priti Patel replaced in major Tory reshuffle
description: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch is shaking up her top team ahead of the party's conference in October.

title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
description: Rescuers have resorted to explosives as they struggle to reach trapped workers, as the flooding death toll reaches 939.

title: Once a village, now barren land - BBC in the valley devastated by floods
description: The BBC reports from Sano Barkhu, a village overlooking the town of Syfrubesi, which was destroyed by the Nepal flooding.

title: Messi retires from Argentina duty with 'nothing left to give'
description: Argentina great Lionel Messi announces his retirement from international football, saying it was a decision that "hurt" but he understands "the time has come".

title: AI could cause global economic downturn, Bank of England chief warns
description: The governor of the Bank of England warned of AI's “volatility” caused by energy shocks from the US-Iran war.

title: Victoria Beckham's company makes its first profit after 18 years
description: Beckham's fashion and beauty business makes a £7.3m operating profit after years of losses.

title: Notting Hill Carnival revels in 60th anniversary celebrations
description: Notting Hill Carnival, Europe's biggest street party, has celebrated its 60th year.

title: Trump pushes Apple to change 'Lake Ontario' to 'Lake America' on its maps
description: The request comes after Google made the switch for US-based users over the weekend. MapQuest, another US map provider, said it will not change the name.

title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
description: Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among 20 missing in an incident that killed eight people.
